root_idea.summary: The root reflects two principal semantic axes: protrusion or elevation, and movement to and fro.
root_idea.development: The protrusion axis appears in names for ridges, raised bones, and prominent parts; the movement axis appears in roaming, the ass, and the caravan. The Quranic عِيرٌ belongs to the latter axis and denotes a provision-bearing caravan.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic noun عِيرٌ is a distinct lexical item meaning a caravan.

senses.definition: A caravan, especially people and pack animals carrying provisions; by extension, a caravan generally.
senses.usage_conditions: A collective noun used in the account of Joseph for the departing or arriving provision caravan. Classical explanations differ over whether the animals were asses or camels; the Quranic usage itself denotes the caravan as a whole.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go, journey, or move to and fro.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used with فِي الأرض for going away in or into a land; of a person, to come and go or move about.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To escape or get loose and wander hither and thither, especially through restlessness or excessive liveliness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to animals such as horses and dogs, and also figuratively to things that circulate or move about.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become current or widely circulated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively of news, an ode, or a verse; the figurative extension is explicitly reported as such in some attestations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go among people causing mischief, including by striking them with a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a person's moving among a group while attacking or troubling them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a male camel, to leave females advanced in pregnancy and go to others to mate with them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-husbandry usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take someone or something and go away with it; hence, to destroy it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transitive construction may describe carrying an object away or causing its destruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To blame, reproach, upbraid, or accuse someone of a fault.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form II construction may take the reproached matter directly or, in a less approved usage, with بِهِ; it can also mean charging someone with disgraceful conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To measure, weigh, compare, or test measures and weighing instruments against one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of checking the correctness or equality of measures, balances, and monetary pieces; the sources distinguish the preferred Form III usage in some constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of water, to become covered with the green growth called طُحْلُب.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported usage whose attribution is questioned in the lexical discussion, which suggests another verb as more probable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assay or test gold and similar material.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as an extension of measuring or comparing for conformity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a horse or dog to escape or run loose, wandering about from liveliness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participial description مُعَارٌ refers to an animal made to escape or run about.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give an arrowhead, spearhead, sword blade, knife blade, or similar object its central raised ridge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The resulting blade is described as having عَيْرٌ, a prominent central line or ridge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a mare, to raise and shift a hoof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equine expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lending of garments and similar articles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported derived noun associated with the Form IV entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In horse terminology, to fatten a horse; also reported, with differing explanations, of plucking the hair of its tail or making it lean and light of flesh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are specialized and partly variant explanations of the horse-related Form IV usage; they should not be generalized beyond that context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask neighbors to lend household goods; to borrow them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V usage explicitly equated with seeking a loan of household articles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To blame, reproach, revile, or vilify one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction, also explained as exchanging accusations of disgrace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Disgrace, shame, vice, or a fault that occasions blame or reproach.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural may denote things for which a person is blamed or reproached.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An ass, whether wild or domestic, especially the wild ass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word occurs in proverbs and comparisons, including expressions concerning an ass that has gone away; its traditional derivation connects it with wandering to and fro.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An empty or unproductive place, figuratively a place in which there is no useful good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed idiomatic expression, literally “the belly of an ass.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lord, chief, or king of a people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal usage distinct from the animal sense; it appears in proverbial language about succession from one lord to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular bird resembling a pigeon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional bird-name, associated with al-Sarāt; its plural is عُيُورُ السَّرَاةِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A prominence, ridge, or protuberant central part: the ridge of a blade, the midrib of a leaf, a spine or raised part of the shoulder, foot, hand or body, a ridge of rock, or a raised strip of an otherwise even surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is extended to various raised anatomical and physical structures. The hand attribution is textually questioned and may refer instead to the shoulder; the broader sense of a prominent part is secure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A prominent or visible part associated with the eye, variously explained as the part at the pupil, the eyelid, the inner angle, the image in the black of the eye, the eyeball, or a glance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical authorities give several competing anatomical and idiomatic interpretations; the expression قَبْلَ عَيْرٍ وَمَا جَرَى refers to an instant or glance before something could occur.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The tragus or another inner part of the ear; in horse terminology, one of the prominent back portions of the ears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The anatomical referent varies among the cited explanations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wooden pin, peg, or stake fixed in the ground or in a wall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense underlies idiomatic and poetic expressions whose precise interpretation is disputed, including phrases involving striking or hunting the عَيْر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of wood in the front part of a هَوْدَج, a covered travel litter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object-name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A drum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported nominal sense, also proposed by some interpreters for a poetic occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mountain, including mountains known by this name near Medina or, according to one report, Mecca.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical name as well as a common noun in the cited lexical account.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A group of bright stars in the track of the feet of Canopus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural astronomical name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A swift, brisk, hardy male or female camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name compares the camel's quickness and frequent circling with that of the wild ass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A standard or measure by which something is measured, compared, adjusted, or equalized; of coins, the rate or standard of fineness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of measures, weights, balances, and the quantity of pure silver or gold in currency.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The currency or circulation of a poem.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized literary usage referring to how widely a poem is current.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression عُيَيْرُ وَحْدِهِ, a person who relies on his own opinion, does not consult or mix with others, or eats alone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional diminutive expression of dispraise, with some variation in the precise characterization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Going to and fro, roaming, or constantly in motion; hence brisk, lively, or restless.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to people, dogs, horses, sheep that move between flocks, camels that leave one group of females for another, and lions ranging in search of prey. Of a person it may also suggest unrestrained pursuit of natural desire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unidentified or unclaimed: an arrow from an unknown shooter, or fallen fruit whose owner is unknown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use describing an object whose source or owner cannot be identified.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse that turns away from the road with its rider.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equine noun; the lexical discussion distinguishes it from a derivation through عَارِيَّةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity or hardship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially in the fixed expressions اِبْنَةُ مِعْيَرٍ and بَنَاتُ مِعْيَرٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Resembling an ass, especially in physical build.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive adjective, not the Form X verbal sense suggested by its pattern.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Comparative proverb based on the ass sense.
The hand attribution is retained as a qualified part of the broader prominence branch.

cautions: The Quranic noun عِيرٌ is a collective caravan term; classical authorities differ over the precise animals included in the caravan.
